blackwell_support: PyTorch: every stable/nightly build >=2.7.0 compiled with CUDA >=12.8 ships sm_120 kernels (PyTorch forum staff). RELEASE.md matrix: 2.9-2.10 stable cu126/cu128 (+exp cu130); 2.11 cu126/cu128/cu130; 2.12-2.14 cu126/cu130 (+cu132); 2.15 (due 28 Oct 2026) cu132 stable only, Python >=3.11.

MEASURED on this RTX 5060 (driver 580.126.09): torch 2.14.1+cu130 arch_list includes sm_120; 8192^3 matmul fp16 38.2 / bf16 38.0 / tf32 19.6 / fp32 13.1 TFLOPS; SDPA flash, mem-efficient and cuDNN backends run; torch.compile (Triton 3.8, system gcc 9.4) compiles and matches eager.

PyTorch dropped cu130 from nightlies from the week of 28 Sep 2026: CUDA toolkits before 13.2.2 have a silent miscompilation bug (nested thread divergence, present since 12.8). 2.14 and earlier keep cu130 wheels; maintainers tell cu130 pinners to move to cu132.

CUDA 13.x minor-version compatibility requires driver >=580, so 580.126 can load cu132/13.4 runtimes; NVIDIA warns apps that JIT-compile PTX at runtime may still need a newer driver. torch cu132 was NOT tested here.

JAX 0.11.2 jax[cuda13] (needs driver >=580, SM >=7.5, Python >=3.12): MEASURED backend gpu, compute_capability 12.0, bf16 matmul 38 TFLOPS. Open Blackwell reports: XLA delay-kernel timeout on SM 12.0a (openxla/xla#39255); Xid 31 MMU fault on RTX 5090 with driver 610 (open-gpu-kernel-modules#1208).
NVIDIA Warp 1.18 PyPI wheels use CUDA 13.4 and need an R580+ driver and sm_75+ (+cu12 wheels on GitHub releases). MEASURED: MuJoCo Warp 3.16 kernels JIT-compile and run on sm_120 with driver 580.126.

Isaac Gym Preview 4: libPhysXGpu_64.so has kernels only up to SM_80 and no PTX; NVIDIA staff (27 Apr 2026): 'There is no workaround', legacy/unsupported, migrate to Isaac Lab. IsaacGymEnvs repo is archived; legged_gym needs Python 3.6-3.8 + Isaac Gym.

Isaac Sim 5.1 PhysX contains SM_120 kernels (NVIDIA staff). RTX 50 supported but driver-sensitive: 5.1 tested on 580.65.06, 6.x on 595.58.03; an RTX 5060 Laptop crashed in 4.5/5.0/5.1 on 595.71 until the driver changed. RTX 50 needs the open kernel module (present here: Dual MIT/GPL).

ManiSkill3 3.0.1 / SAPIEN 3.0.3 GPU PhysX: MEASURED working on sm_120 (state and Vulkan RGB). First GPU use silently downloads libPhysXGpu_64.so (78 MB) from GitHub; on slow links pre-download it into ~/.sapien/physx/105.1-physx-5.3.1.patch0/.
Genesis 1.4.4 (Quadrants 1.3.3 compiler) with torch cu130: MEASURED working on sm_120, including the official Go2 PPO locomotion example.
bitsandbytes 0.50.2: Linux x86-64 NVIDIA SM60+ (glibc >=2.24). MEASURED: nf4 double-quant QLoRA forward/backward runs on sm_120.

Unsloth lists RTX 5060-5090 as supported; its Blackwell guide: Python 3.12, vLLM built for cu128, xformers from source with TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0, do not upgrade triton separately. Not run here; vLLM 0.32.0 pins torch==2.13.0 (untested).

flash-attn 2.8.3.post2 is sdist-only on PyPI (needs nvcc, absent here); torch's own SDPA flash backend already works. gsplat now requires PyTorch >=2.7 (CUDA 12.8/13.2 builds). MASt3R-SLAM README pins torch 2.5.1 / CUDA <=12.4, so its extensions need rebuilding for sm_120.
os_python_notes: glibc 2.31 satisfies: torch (manylinux_2_28), jaxlib + jax-cuda13-plugin (2_27), mujoco (2_27/2_28), warp-lang (2_28), sapien (2_28), quadrants (2_27/2_28), bitsandbytes (2_24), vllm (2_28). Verified by wheel tags; most also by install.

glibc 2.31 BLOCKS pip isaacsim >=5.0 (manylinux_2_35; 4.x used 2_34) and isaaclab 2.3.x (2_35, Python 3.11 only); Isaac docs: 'GLIBC 2.35+ required'. BEHAVIOR-1K setup.sh pins isaacsim 5.1.0, so it is blocked too.

System Python 3.8 is unusable: torch >=2.9 needs >=3.10 (2.15 needs >=3.11); JAX 0.11 and LeRobot 0.6 need >=3.12; Playground >=3.11; Genesis 3.10-3.13; Isaac Sim 5.x =3.11, 6.x =3.12. Default to Python 3.12.

MEASURED: uv 0.13.1 + uv-managed CPython 3.12.15 (glibc-independent python-build-standalone via UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_MIRROR=npmmirror) installed and ran everything here. Keep torch stack and JAX stack in separate venvs (they pull different nvidia-* libs: CUDA 13.0 vs 13.4).

conda/Miniforge also bypasses system glibc (not tested by me) and is required for Habitat-sim: aihabitat channel 0.3.3 (py3.9 headless/bullet builds, Jan 2025) or aihabitat-nightly (py3.10-3.12, built 2026-10-19).

MEASURED network from this host: download.pytorch.org ~0.2 MB/s, GitHub ~0.05 MB/s, huggingface.co ~0.06 MB/s, nvcr.io ~0.4 MB/s; mirrors.aliyun.com (PyPI + pytorch-wheels/cu130) ~6 MB/s, ModelScope ~2 MB/s. Install torch with --find-links https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pytorch-wheels/cu130/.

Docker 28.1.1 + nvidia-container-toolkit 1.20.1: MEASURED 'docker run --gpus all' sees RTX 5060 (cc 12.0). daemon.json defines the nvidia runtime but 'docker info' lists only runc (daemon restart likely pending); --gpus works anyway.
No CUDA toolkit/nvcc on host (gcc 9.4 only). Building CUDA extensions (flash-attn, xformers, gsplat from source, MASt3R curope) needs pip nvidia-cuda-nvcc or a CUDA -devel container.
No iGPU on i7-14700KF, so Xorg sits on the 5060 (~1.1-1.3 GB). MEASURED free 6.27 GiB of 7.52 GiB; largest single allocation 5.5 GiB. Train from a TTY / stopped display manager to reclaim ~1.2 GB.

training_budget_examples: MEASURED: Genesis official go2_train.py (rsl-rl-lib 5.5.1 PPO), 4096 envs x 101 iterations: 99.7 s wall-clock end to end (incl. scene build/compile), ~0.33 s/iter, ~300k steps/s; episode length reached max 1001, reward ~15.6; GPU peak ~2.9 GB incl. Xorg, 87% util.
MEASURED: Genesis Go2 sim-only PD stepping: 1024 envs 1.09M env-steps/s (+1.3 GB); 4096 envs 1.67M (+3.7 GB); 8192 envs OOM.
MEASURED: mjwarp-testspeed humanoid: 4096 worlds 2.10M steps/s (10,482x realtime); 8192 worlds 2.06M steps/s.
MEASURED: MJX (JAX) toy 12-DoF quadruped, batch 4096: 469k steps/s, 5.9 s JIT.
MEASURED: ManiSkill3 PickCube, state obs, 4096 envs: 45.7k control-steps/s; RGB 128x128, 256 envs: 4.75k/s.
MEASURED: Qwen3-VL-2B fine-tune step (bs1, seq 230): QLoRA 0.26 s / 2.76 GiB; LoRA bf16 0.18 s / 4.65 GiB. Extrapolated: 10k samples per epoch ~30-45 min.
Paper: Rudin et al., CoRL 2021 (arXiv 2109.11978): ANYmal flat-terrain policy in under 4 min, rough terrain in 20 min, on a single workstation GPU with thousands of parallel robots.
Paper: MuJoCo Playground (arXiv 2502.08844): Go1 flat-ground joystick within 5 min on 2x RTX 4090; LeapCubeReorient ~2080 s on 1x 4090 vs ~670 s on 8x H100 (8192 envs).
Isaac Lab docs (1x RTX 4090, headless): Velocity-Rough-G1, 4096 envs: 94k env FPS, 82k with training, 6.1 GB VRAM.
Unsloth minimum VRAM (QLoRA / LoRA-16bit): 3B 3.5/8 GB, 7B 5/19, 8B 6/22, 9B 6.5/24. GRPO: '5GB VRAM is enough' for models <=1.5B; rule of thumb QLoRA VRAM ~ params in B as GB.
LeRobot SmolVLA docs: 20k steps ~4 h on one A100 (bs 64). Expect several times longer on the 5060 with a smaller batch (estimate, not measured).
hard_limits: Usable VRAM ~6.3 GiB while Xorg runs on the 5060 (no iGPU); largest single allocation measured 5.5 GiB.
Isaac Gym Preview 4 GPU PhysX cannot run on Blackwell, so legacy legged_gym pipelines must be ported.
No pip install on Ubuntu 20.04 for Isaac Sim >=4.0 (wheels need glibc 2.34/2.35), Isaac Lab 2.3 or BEHAVIOR-1K, and no Webots R2025a package: needs containers or an OS upgrade to 22.04/24.04.
Isaac Sim official minimum is 16 GB VRAM (RTX 4080); RTX-camera Isaac Lab tasks (e.g. Cartpole-RGB 16.7 GB) will not fit.
7-9B VLMs/VLAs (Uni-NaVid, NaVILA, OpenVLA, Qwen3-VL-8B) do not fit in bf16; int4 is borderline; full fine-tuning impossible, QLoRA marginal.
pi0 / pi0.5 / GR00T (2.7-3.6B) inference is borderline in bf16; training needs LoRA + quantization or a rented GPU.
Genesis Go2 at 8192 envs runs out of memory; cap at ~4096 envs.

Driver 580 is native CUDA 13.0; newer runtimes rely on minor-version compatibility. Isaac Sim 6.x is validated on 595, but upgrading risks Isaac 5.1 stability (RTX 5060 Laptop crash report on 595.71).
Anthropic API: mainland China and Hong Kong are unsupported (including China-controlled entities). OpenAI/Google region status not checked.
Slow GitHub/HF/nvcr.io from this host: the SAPIEN PhysX lib, MuJoCo Menagerie, Isaac images and HF weights can stall setups. Use Aliyun/ModelScope mirrors or a proxy.
One GPU, no cluster: no multi-GPU scaling; large ablations need rental.
No nvcc on host, so CUDA-extension builds need an extra toolchain.
recommended_stack: Leave system Python 3.8 alone. Use uv 0.13 with uv-managed CPython 3.12 venvs and the Aliyun PyPI + pytorch-wheels mirrors (Miniforge only for Habitat). venv A (verified): torch 2.14.1+cu130, torchvision 0.29.1, Genesis 1.4.4, rsl-rl-lib 5.5.1, ManiSkill3 3.0.1, transformers 5.20, peft 0.21, bitsandbytes 0.50.2. venv B (verified): jax[cuda13] 0.11.2, mujoco/mujoco-mjx/mujoco-warp 3.16, warp-lang 1.18 (+playground). Stay on cu130 / torch <=2.14 with driver 580 until cu132 is tested; do not chase driver 595. Simulators: Genesis as primary quadruped RL with the robot's URDF (official Go2 PPO took ~100 s here); MuJoCo Warp / MJX-Playground as a second engine for sim2sim checks; ManiSkill3 for manipulation and Go2-Reach; Habitat-sim (conda nightly) for VLN/ObjectNav benchmarks; Isaac Lab only in a container or after upgrading to 22.04/24.04, headless, state-only, <=4096 envs; ROS 2 Jazzy/Humble + Gazebo in Docker as the real-robot bridge. Models: Qwen3-VL-2B or Qwen3.5-2B in bf16 as an on-device planner (~1 Hz, LoRA/QLoRA locally), MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B for a faster loop; YOLOE or Grounding-DINO-tiny + SAM 2.1-small + Depth Anything V2/DA3-small + DINOv2/v3 features; ViNT/NoMaD as navigation baselines; SmolVLA if a VLA is needed. Rent 24-80 GB GPUs only for 7-9B VLN/VLA baselines (Uni-NaVid, NaVILA) and big ablations. Optional cloud planner: Gemini Flash/Flash-Lite or Qwen via DashScope (Claude API unavailable from mainland China). Train without Xorg to free ~1.2 GB VRAM.
cloud_fallbacks: Assumption: 1 decision = 1 camera image + prompt (~1k input tokens) + ~200 output tokens. Cost per 1k decisions = 1000 x (1k x input price + 0.2k x output price) / 1M.

Claude (official pricing, USD/MTok in/out): Haiku 5.5 0.10/0.50 (prompts <=100k): ~$0.20 per 1k decisions; Sonnet 5.5 2/10: ~$4; Opus 5.5 4/20: ~$8; Batch API -50%. Not available in mainland China/HK.
